known_limitations: PROBED 2026-11-09: the Comext dissemination API works keyless and returned real 2023 values (DE imports of HS 9018 from US: 2,682,137,903 EUR; exports 3,376,125,154 EUR).

Two call-shape traps were confirmed live: (1) Comext lives under /api/comext/dissemination/... - the mainstream /api/dissemination/... path answers 404 'DS-045409 ... is not available for dissemination'; (2) the dimensions are freq/reporter/partner/product/flow/indicators/time - using geo= returns 400 'Dimension "GEO" is not defined'.
The dataset 'updated' timestamp is a refresh clock, not a per-record publication date; per-record public visibility cannot be reconstructed.
Country-level aggregate by CN8/HS: no company, no shipment, no product identity.

Country-level HS-code AGGREGATE statistics only: no company, no shipment, no product identity. Must not be substituted for bill-of-lading (company-level) data, and cannot be used to infer any of the five firms' supply chain.
licence: Eurostat data reuse policy: free reuse with attribution (Commission Decision 2011/833/EU)
rate_limits: undocumented; respectful use required (bulk download offered separately)
research_value: The best free monthly HS-code aggregate for the EU market, with CN8 detail (useful for device sub-categories) and a clean keyless API. It gives the European macro demand backdrop for the same HS codes used with Comtrade/Census, but says nothing about any firm.
source_name: Eurostat Comext (EU trade since 1988 by HS2-4-6 and CN8)
timestamp_fields: freq/time = month or year (coarse) -> source_public_at cannot be better than month
dataset 'updated' = a dataset refresh timestamp, NOT the publication date of a given figure
